geometry.bits: S sector first, conditional G energy second: U11=Vs strong, U10=Vs weak, U01=Vw strong, U00=Vw weak
geometry.definition: Full S right frame then eig(V_sector* G*G V_sector); not simultaneous SVD or exact intersection of global S/G strong spaces
geometry.real_material_rule: stack(Re operator, Im operator) before all steps; original frames mean pre-conditional full right frames in the selected scalar domain
geometry.eigen_order: ascending; raw eigenvalues used for >= threshold selection
geometry.zero_operator_threshold_policy: Literal declared >= threshold including zero; numerical null ranks separately reported; no synthetic padding
geometry.identity_validation_null_reason: Previously characterized public geometry; no repeated identity checks in online solve
geometry.global_projector_noncommutator_norm_defi: Frobenius norm of Ps Pg - Pg Ps for independent global tau-strong projectors
geometry.cost_scope: Public operator SVD/Gram/eigh/diagnostics only, no physical LU/RHS; validation products charged

denominator.basis_selection: external supplied fixed U; no SVD or padding
denominator.neighbor: Original disjoint4cell off-diagonal N; residual R=N-PNP
denominator.qualification: No all-box contraction guarantee for the truncated residual hop

exclusion: Excluded from extra rational/routing feedback, not from Maxwell data/material DOF; local residual hop retained
reflection: P_H on BOTH scaled current and field increments; full Maxell projectors; not frequency-decoupled feasibility
